description: Repairs r-sort-3/create-corpus-accdb: the intermediate whole-file images of the build stages were size-only (unread: IOException 0x80070020, file in use), so the fresh-versus-incremental builds of T and T2 were not retained as images. Asks, on a copy of fixture r-sort-3-corpus-accdb (ACCDB), with the database closed and its image kept after each step (every step is its own read/write open): TS(ID, K, G) filled from T in ID order, no index; IX_K on TS (fresh build); IX_KD on TS; T2S with IX_K and IX_KD created empty; T2S filled by INSERT..SELECT from TS ORDER BY ID (incremental build). Then, through a read-only open, SQL ORDER BY K and the IX_K and IX_KD walks of TS and T2S.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-fmt-sort probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.

args.text: CREATE TABLE TS (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_TS PRIMARY KEY, K TEXT(255), G TEXT(16))
INSERT INTO TS (ID, K, G) SELECT ID, K, G FROM T ORDER BY ID
CREATE INDEX IX_KD ON TS (K DESC)
CREATE TABLE T2S (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_T2S PRIMARY KEY, K TEXT(255), G TEXT(16))
